structured_output.summary: The change implements Iterator.prototype.join in its own file, step by step, with each spec step kept as a comment above its code. I checked the order of operations against the spec: the TypeError check on `this` comes first, then the separator ToString (with IfAbruptCloseIterator), then GetIteratorDirect, then the step loop. Within each loop pass, the separator is appended before the value is converted, and value ToString errors close the iterator. Every ? and abrupt completion is propagated, with no catch-alls or defaults. No test-specific branches or hardcoded results. The only change outside the function body is the `new_target` parameter becoming `_new_target`, which follows from the body no longer using it. I could not inspect `ops::iterator_step_value`, `ops::get_iterator_direct` or `if_abrupt_close_iterator` directly. Whether they set [[Done]] on a throw and close the iterator correctly is outside this diff, so it is not verified here.
